title: DidVerifiableCredentialV1
description:
Interface describing a verifiable credential.
https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-model-1.1

@context.description: The context for the verifiable credential.

issuanceDate.description: The date the verifiable credential was issued, depending on version validFrom might be set instead.

expirationDate.description: The date the verifiable credential expires, depending on version validUntil might be set instead.
